component_name: Salinity Gradient Blue Energy (Pressure-Retarded Osmosis, PRO)
fidelity: F2a — Osmotic Flux Lumped Module (Jw / Js with concentration polarization + module ODE)
source: Loeb (1976) J. Membr. Sci. 1:49; Lee, Baker, Lonsdale (1981) J. Membr. Sci. 8:141; Achilli, Cath & Childress (2009) J. Membr. Sci. 343:42; Yip & Elimelech (2011) Environ. Sci. Technol. 45:10273; Straub, Deshmukh & Elimelech (2016) Energy Environ. Sci. 9:31; Statkraft Tofte pilot (2009).

unit.name: Seawater(draw)/River(feed) PRO module — physics-lumped osmotic flux

A_perm.note: Water permeability coefficient (A). 5e-12 m/s/Pa ~= 1.8 L/m2/h/bar, typical TFC PRO membrane (Yip & Elimelech 2011)

B_salt.note: Salt (NaCl) permeability coefficient (B). Reverse salt flux driver (Achilli 2009)

S_struct.note: Membrane support layer structural parameter S = t*tau/eps (300 um). Governs internal concentration polarization (Lee et al. 1981)

k_ecp.note: External (draw-side) mass-transfer coefficient for concentration polarization (Achilli 2009)

D_salt.note: NaCl diffusion coefficient in water at 25 C (CRC Handbook)

A_mem.note: Total membrane area of the lumped module

V_draw.note: Lumped draw-side volume for module concentration ODE

eta_turbine.note: Hydro-turbine efficiency converting pressurized permeate to electricity (Statkraft)
